keyVerseDR: "This people honoureth me with their lips, but their heart is far from me." (Mk 7:6)

level1.title: A Clean Heart
level1.story: Some leaders cared only about washing hands the right way. Jesus said, "God looks at your heart!" Bad things come from inside, not outside.
level1.heartIntro: Draw inside the heart, then color it!
questions: What did Jesus say matters most?
How can you keep your heart clean?
level1.prayer: Jesus, give me a clean heart. Amen.

activity.title: A clean heart
activity.intro: Sort each one: does it come from a heart full of light or darkness?

level2.title: Lips and Hearts
level2.story: The Pharisees saw some of Jesus' disciples eating without washing their hands as tradition required. Jesus said Isaiah was right: "This people honoureth Me with their lips, but their heart is far from Me." He called the crowd and said, "Hear ye Me all, and understand." Nothing from outside a person can defile him. Jesus said it is from within, out of the heart, that evil thoughts come.
level2.keyLine: This people honoureth me with their lips, but their heart is far from me.
level2.heartIntro: Write 3 ways you can do each, then color the border!
questions: Why does God care most about the heart?
How can prayer be more than words?
level2.prayer: Lord, make my heart close to You. Amen.

activity.title: Look at my heart
activity.intro: God looks at the heart. Check yours this week.
items: Did I pray with my heart?

art.mainBrief: Child washing hands while heart glows
